threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think you can catch a Tube during rush hour. Good luck! It's like the whole city forgot how to queue.
Last Friday on the 196, a guy started singing ‘Wonderwall’ to a bus full of strangers; by the end, we were all harmonizing. Magic happens on the night bus.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a family of ducks waddling down Karl-Marx-Straße, completely indifferent to the bustling traffic. It felt like a scene straight from a quirky film.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find cafes with a side of Turkish breakfast and street art on every corner that tells stories from decades of change.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate the BART chaos; they’ve learned to avoid Civic Center like it’s on fire, which, at times, it kinda is.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus yesterday with a guy loudly reading a Yelp review to the driver. About tacos. He nearly missed his stop, but we all laughed.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just grab a cafe con leche on every corner like back home. Here, it’s a serious ritual—don’t rush it!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still asking for the 'barcelona' pronunciation with the soft 'c'—the locals dropped that a long time ago.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the Tube without a hint of sarcasm. And you look genuinely confused when your Oyster card beeps at the wrong gate.
Caught the 59 last night; three teenagers had a debate on whether they could beat a pigeon in a race. The pigeon was clearly winning, no contest.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was in Neukölln when I saw a kid selling homemade lemonade outside a Späti while a tango lesson was happening in the park behind him.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice the guys selling currywurst will whip up a cocktail for you? Only in Friedrichshain can you get street food and homemade drinks at the same stand.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they’re locals when they solely order burritos from the same taco truck, no matter the lineup or latest Yelp rave. It’s about loyalty, not trends.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy playing a ukulele on the 31. He was belting out 'San Francisco' while dodging the swaying crowd. That moment felt like an anthem to all our delays.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the squares, but the real vibe is in the side streets, where the locals spill out onto the pavement after eight.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion at the vermut hour; locals know to avoid ordering wine before 1 PM.
